scenes.title: Ambush

lines.t:
CHAPTER 7
The Four Crews
…and then the ramen guy said 'second bowl's free for heroes' and I said 'he's a hero, I'm his manager'—
You're not my manager.
Not yet.
The streetlights go out one by one. Frost spreads across the pavement. Lightning crackles on a rooftop.
Evening, Parker.
From the shadows step the four crews. Frostfire Dominion. Iron Fang. Phantom Veil. Storm Hounds. All of them.
Nothing personal. You beat Dex. You stopped a villain. People are starting to say your name.
And names are dangerous. The crews decide who rises in this school.
We're not waiting until you're too strong to stop.
John. Run.
Not a chance. I copied Gorran's strength when he walked past. I've got one minute. Let's make it count.
It was never a fair fight.
Peter stood in front of John until he couldn't stand. John stood in front of Peter until his copied strength ran out.
When the sirens finally came, the crews were long gone.
Nexa Central Hospital. Two beds side by side. John sleeps, bandaged, breathing slowly.
He got hurt because of me. Because I'm not strong enough.
Three special cards. A System. And I still couldn't protect my best friend.
I need more. Much more. And I can't get it here.
Peter takes out his phone. His hands shake as he types.
Mom, I'm okay. Please don't worry. I have to go away for a while to become stronger. I can't tell you where. I love you more than anything. I'll come home. I promise.

John — thank you for standing with me. You're the bravest person I know. I'm going away to get strong enough that nobody can ever hurt you again. Don't look for me. I'll be back. Save me a bowl of ramen.
He doesn't say where he's going. He doesn't know himself.
System. Can you take me somewhere I can train? Somewhere far away?

REQUEST: TELEPORT HOST TO A DISTANT PLANET
Warning: destination selected by the System.
Light swallows the hospital room. When the nurse checks at dawn, Peter's bed is empty.
